answer:
To find the volume of concrete needed for the continuous footing:

1. Convert the dimensions to feet:
   - Length = 187 ft
   - Width = 2 ft 7 in = $2 + \frac{7}{12} \approx 2.5833$ ft
   - Depth = 1 ft 2 in = $1 + \frac{2}{12} \approx 1.1667$ ft

2. Calculate the volume in cubic feet:
   $\text{Volume} = 187 \text{ ft} \times 2.5833 \text{ ft} \times 1.1667 \text{ ft} = 563.833 \text{ cu ft}$

3. Convert cubic feet to cubic yards (divide by 27):
   $\text{Volume in CY} = \frac{563.833}{27} \approx 20.8827 \text{ CY}$

4. Add 7% waste:
   $\text{Total with waste} = 20.8827 \times 1.07 \approx 22.34 \text{ CY}$

FINAL: 22.34 CY
